title: Davis takes SAP security training; he and Grusch discuss hidden SCIs vs SAPs

tellings.quote: I went through when I was at Erol space I went through special Access program security training

plain: A man named Eric W. Davis says that while working at the Aerospace Corporation, a research company, he went through security training for special access programs, the most tightly restricted kind of secret US government project, where only people on a named list may know about them. He also says he and David Grusch, a man who has come forward as a witness, talked about how secrets might be hidden inside SCIs, short for sensitive compartmented information, a separate category of classified intelligence, rather than inside special access programs. Davis tells it from his own experience, to explain where information about UFOs could be kept out of sight.
